correctness.rationale: Exact coordinates reduce the four-point ratio to three monotonic one-variable steps. The key square-root comparison has difference 4 H^2 h^2; the next derivative has sign v^2-u^2; the final derivative is u^3/[2H(u^2+H^2)^(3/2)]. Equality propagates uniquely to equal half-lengths L/4 and midpoint offset L/2. No finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete branch of the rectangle Ptolemy optimization, not an arbitrary slice: it corresponds exactly to quadruples split two-and-two across opposite supporting sides. The theorem converts a previously published witness into an exact restricted extremum, classifies equality, and rigorously rules this entire infinite branch out as a global maximizer.
